notes.text: In the linked passage Rav Dimi bar Shishna states a teaching in Rav’s name.

[Heilprin’s Shishna cross-reference](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3317&lang=en) sends readers to Shashna. [His entry on Rav Dimi](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=915&lang=en) spells the patronymic Shashna but cites Gittin 62a.
